info.title: Second Memory API
info.description: Second Memory admin API. Admin routes authenticate with the Sanctum session cookie: call `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie`, then `POST /admin/credential/login`, and send the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on writes (ADR-0004). Every response uses the `{ data, error: { status, code, messages } }` envelope.

get.summary: Audit log, newest first by default (read-only, ADR-0006)

post.summary: Log in: starts the session. Call `GET /api/sanctum/csrf-cookie` first
Log out: ends the session (also succeeds without one)

get.summary: Return an empty response simply to trigger the storage of the CSRF cookie in the browser

The skill of a goal is fixed. `achieved` is set only by a level change (REQ-002 US-6),
so the status can be switched between open and dropped only.

UpdateSkillRequest.description:
No level field: levels change only through skill-level/store, so the history stays complete.
The slug is not editable either; public URLs stay stable across renames.
